newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Chun Tai says IPO 168 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK's Chun Tai says IPO 168 times oversubscribed.

text.p: Initial public offering (IPO) of shares of consumer electronic products manufacturer Chun Tai Holdings Ltd was 168.41 times oversubscribed in Hong Kong, the company said on Tuesday.

The company said it received applications for a total of 12.50 billion shares compared with 73.80 million new shares available for public subscription. Another 8.2 million shares reserved for staff were also fully allotted.
Trading in shares of Chun Tai is expected to commence on February 3, 1997, it said.

Chun Tai offered 82 million new shares at HK$1.03 each in the IPO, raising a net proceed of about HK$71 million to fund establishment of a new production plant in China's Zhongshan, and to finance the research and development projects.
Chu Tai manufactures consumer electronics products and toys, including audio and telecommunications equipment, electronic toys and small home appliances.
